purpose: Must-fire and must-stay-quiet spellings for the architecture rules that close a class of mistake (SL-001 m5, m6, m11, m3, M-add-1, m1). Each rule is run over each row's text at each row's path, with the rule's files glob and except_files applied. A rule is not pinned until it has both kinds of row.

bounded_by.request-derived scheme and host (m6): Ordinary handler code in which the request is named r, req or request: the Host field, the TLS field, URL.Host and URL.Scheme, the Referer accessor, and Header.Get, Header.Values or an index with the key host, origin or referer in any letter case, in double quotes or backticks, with or without spaces inside the call. Not bounded: a request under another name, a header key assembled at run time, a header map copied to a variable first. The structural answer for those is that no handler is given a URL builder other than the one that reads the configured base URL.
bounded_by.redirect-writing (m11, M-add-1): Every way ordinary code answers a redirect: http.Redirect, http.RedirectHandler, a Set, Add or index write of the Location key in any letter case with double quotes or backticks, any of the five redirect status constants, and a numeric 30x passed to WriteHeader. The only file allowed to do so is internal/auth/next.go. Not bounded: a key or status held in a variable, http.ResponseController, a reverse proxy.
bounded_by.escaping bypass (m5): Ordinary ways site HTML skips html/template: importing text/template under any import spelling, importing html/template under an alias or dot (which hides typed conversions from the conversion pattern), a typed conversion to any of the seven template types, and a Go string literal, interpreted or raw, that starts with markup. Not bounded: markup assembled from pieces, bytes read from a file and written as they are.
bounded_by.sign-in control shape (m3): A form element whose action attribute, or a button whose formaction attribute, names the sign-in URL, in a template file, with any quoting and any letter case. Not bounded: an action built from template variables that hide the path.
bounded_by.report bytes and report files (SL-003 m5: Ordinary ways code reaches report bytes outside serveRaw: http.ServeContent, ServeFile and ServeFileFS; a file server over a directory (http.FileServer, http.Dir) and os.DirFS, anywhere in the repository including the entrypoint; and any mention of .OpenRaw, a call or a method value, split over lines or not, outside raw.go, admin.go and the library. Not bounded: io.Copy of an opened file, an aliased net/http import, a function value named something else, bytes read with os.ReadFile and written by hand. The publishedOnly argument of the public handler is pinned by TestHiddenReportsAreIndistinguishable, not by a pattern.
bounded_by.draft-returning calls (SL-003 m5): Every spelling of a call to BySlug or ListAll outside admin.go and the library, as a call, a call split over lines, or a method value. The public byte path in raw.go is not excepted. Not bounded: a library method added later that returns drafts under another name.
bounded_by.frame elements and sandbox tokens (SL-00: A frame element (iframe, frame, fencedframe, object, embed) in any non-Go file under internal/ other than the two audited templates, in any letter case, with attributes on the same or the next line, including static pages served under the site policy; and a sandbox attribute carrying allow-scripts, allow-same-origin, allow-top-navigation or allow-forms, or an srcdoc attribute, in any non-Go file, with double, single or no quotes. Not bounded: an element assembled by a template from variables, a frame created by script, a page outside internal/.
bounded_by.dislike tally producer (SL-004): Every call or method value of OwnerTally outside admin.go, internal/votes and tests: the token with a leading dot, so a call, a method value and a call split over lines all fire. Not bounded: a dislike field added to votes.PublicView inside internal/votes (no rule applies there; TestDislikesDoNotInterfere observes every reader page, the owner's included, and fails on it), or a second producer written inside internal/votes.
bounded_by.votes table SQL (SL-004 M-add-1): Upper-case FROM, INTO, UPDATE and JOIN followed by votes; UPDATE OR <conflict> votes; and a comma join whose FROM keyword is in the same string literal as the table name (the pattern stops at a quote, a backtick or a semicolon, so a Go argument list such as render(w, votes) stays quiet). Not bounded (CC-001): lower-case SQL, a table name built by concatenation, a quoted or schema-qualified name (FROM "votes", FROM main.votes), a comma join across two string literals, and a view or trigger over votes created by a later .sql migration, which no Go-file glob can see. The quiet rows vote-sql-q003 to q006 pin these as known-quiet: whoever closes one flips its row to fire.
bounded_by.transactions in internal/votes (SL-004 M: Inside internal/votes (tests excepted), every spelling of Begin or BeginTx as a call, the words BEGIN and SAVEPOINT in any letter case as whole words, and sql.Tx by name. A word merely containing the keyword (begins, BeginTx without a call) is not a whole word and stays quiet. Not bounded: a transaction opened outside the package and handed in through an interface other than sql.Tx, and a statement spelled by concatenation. Every row carries the path internal/votes/votes.go so the rule applies to it.
bounded_by.comments table SQL (SL-006): Upper-case FROM, INTO, UPDATE and JOIN followed by comments; UPDATE OR <conflict> comments; and a comma join whose FROM keyword is in the same string literal as the table name. Not bounded (CC-001): lower-case SQL, a table name built by concatenation, a quoted or schema-qualified name, a comma join across two string literals, and a view or trigger over comments created by a later .sql migration. The quiet rows cmt-sql-q003 to q006 pin these as known-quiet: whoever closes one flips its row to fire.
bounded_by.transactions in internal/comments (SL-00: Inside internal/comments (tests excepted), every spelling of Begin or BeginTx as a call, the words BEGIN and SAVEPOINT in any letter case as whole words, and sql.Tx by name. Not bounded: a transaction opened outside the package and handed in through an interface other than sql.Tx, and a statement spelled by concatenation. Every fire row carries a path under internal/comments so the rule applies to it.
bounded_by.write handlers resolve the poster (SL-00: Every call of ViewerFrom in a non-test file of internal/server other than reader.go and admin.go, whatever the file is named. Not bounded: a helper placed in reader.go or admin.go, or in internal/auth, that wraps ViewerFrom and is called by a write handler (cmt-vf-q005 pins it as known-quiet). TestCommentStoreFailure is the behavioural guard for that gap: a POST while the session lookup fails answers 503 and stores nothing.
bounded_by.site script sinks and requests (SL-006 m: In any file under internal/server/static: assignment to innerHTML or outerHTML through a property access, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write and writeln, eval and new Function, setHTML and setHTMLUnsafe, parseHTML and parseHTMLUnsafe, createContextualFragment, parseFromString, srcdoc as a property or through setAttribute, fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon, WebSocket and any name that continues it (WebSocketStream), EventSource and WebTransport. Not bounded: image and link-prefetch beacons (new Image().src), import(), Worker and serviceWorker.register, form.submit() and requestSubmit(), outerHTML reached through a variable or bracket access, and any DOM sink the list does not name. The quiet rows cmt-js-q003 to q007 pin these as known-quiet.
